newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Nov qtr job vacancies up 7.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Nov qtr job vacancies up 7.9 pct.

text.p: Australian job vacancies rose a seasonally adjusted 7.9 percent between August and November, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said on Thursday.
The November rise followed a 2.0 percent fall in the three months to August, which the bureau revised from the 1.2 percent fall it originally reported.
November job vacancies stood 11.2 percent higher than a year before.
Trend data -- moving averages that iron out bumps -- showed zero change in vacancies in the quarter but a 2.5 percent rise over the year.
Overtime worked by the average overtime-working employee fell 1.5 percent in the quarter in seasonally adjusted terms but remained 3.2 percent above its level of a year before.
Trend overtime fell 1.4 percent in the quarter and was up 0.8 percent on November 1995.
